name: mfg-copilot
description: Manufacturing OEE & Maintenance Decision Copilot — an ontology-powered Snowflake copilot that explains why OEE is deteriorating, identifies the asset threatening production, and recommends a safe, feasible maintenance response. Enforces deterministic data-quality, safety, and feasibility gates before ranking options; requires role-appropriate human approval before any controlled write; never controls equipment.
